batches.description: all exec-API sink sites (subprocess Popen/check_output/check_call/call/run; shell=True marker rows folded into their Popen entries) - hand-reviewed line by line against source

internal_exec_wrapper function sites (build/doc/GPU/git/sizetrack/slurm/tflite-schema wrappers) - hand-reviewed; all labeled none/fp because the contained exec calls are labeled directly and local taint flow propagates wrapper parameters
cmd_format string-construction sites (str.format / %-format) - hand-reviewed; all are command-flag construction, path joins, error messages or logging, not execution APIs

tfdbg gRPC network receive boundaries: SendEvents/SendTracebacks/SendSourceFiles servicer params, on_value_event/on_graph_def/on_core_metadata_event callbacks (context/timestamp args -> none), and the 3 stream_handler dispatch sites -> summary
network fetch + decode boundaries: urlopen responses, json.loads/json.load, ParseFromString proto decode
CLI input: sys.argv reads, parse_args/parse_known_args results, input()/self._input interactive prompts
add_argument CLI flag declarations - none/fp (declarative; values surface at parse_args)
environment reads: os.environ subscript, os.environ.get, os.getenv (zone-differentiated: library vs build tooling vs test support)
file opens: open/GFile/Open with read vs write mode distinguished from the source line
entries at/below confidence 0.55 were re-checked against source before confirming (WORKFLOW 4.4.4 batch policy)
